## Live Software Products
- **Bide+** — https://bideplus.eus
  Installable real-time public transport PWA covering 16 transit networks across Euskal Herria (Bizkaibus, Metro Bilbao, Euskotren, Renfe Cercanías, Bilbobus, Dbus, Tuvisa, Alavabus, Lurraldebus, and more). Features an empirically validated real-time ETA engine achieving 64% accuracy (±2 min) versus 39% for the official Bizkaibus app across 555,744 paired GPS ground-truth evaluations.
- **Gasolinera+** — https://gasolineraplus.app
  Real-time Spanish fuel price comparator covering 11,400+ official MITECO stations, with personal vehicle fuel/consumption logger (L/100km), live onboard trip computer, and interactive price heatmaps. Live and installable today on iPhone (iOS) and Android as a PWA, with Google Play Store release forthcoming.

## Open-Science Research Publications (Zenodo · Google Scholar Indexed)
Archive index: https://yeraygarrido.dev/papers/
Reference repository: https://github.com/Garridoparrayeray/bide-eta

1. **Accuracy of open-data versus operator real-time bus arrival predictions: a paired evaluation of the Bide+ method in Biscay, Spain** (Preprint v1.0, EN, 2026-11-16)
   - DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24286027
   - Scholar landing page: https://yeraygarrido.dev/papers/paired-evaluation/
   - Preprint PDF: https://yeraygarrido.dev/papers/Garrido_2026_Open-data_vs_operator_real-time_bus_predictions_preprint_v1.0.pdf
   - Key findings: 555,744 paired predictions against GPS ground truth; Bide+ reaches 64% vs 39% official app accuracy (±2 min), winning 57 of 59 stops.

2. **Predicting bus arrivals when the feed reports positions but not delays: a reproducible three-layer method with an open reference implementation** (Preprint v1.1, EN, 2026-11-16)
   - DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24286302
   - Scholar landing page: https://yeraygarrido.dev/papers/three-layer-method/
   - Preprint PDF: https://yeraygarrido.dev/papers/Garrido_2026_Bus_arrival_prediction_three-layer_method_preprint_v1.1.pdf
   - Key findings: Reproducible 3-layer architecture (geometric projection, last-stop + explicit abstention, shrunk learned medians) evaluated over 9.1 million predictions (92–96% within ±3 min, 2× published timetable accuracy).

3. **Predicción de llegadas de autobuses con posiciones en tiempo real y horarios interpolados** (Technical Monograph v2.1, ES, 200 pages, 2026-11-07)
   - DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24041572
   - Scholar landing page: https://yeraygarrido.dev/papers/memoria-bide-eta/
   - Monograph PDF: https://yeraygarrido.dev/papers/Garrido_2026_Prediccion_llegadas_autobuses_memoria_v2.1.pdf
   - Key findings: 200-page mathematical and engineering reference monograph including Kalman filtering, residual neural network (-7% additional error), and 407 verified test vectors.

## Other Selected Software Projects

- **GastroAccess Euskadi**: React/TypeScript SPA consuming Open Data Euskadi APIs for venue accessibility scoring.
- **Zalbi Aisia**: Custom native CMS with asynchronous taxonomic filtering and SEO/GEO optimization.
- **Ayuntamiento de Bermeo — Lost & Found System** (May–Jun 2026): End-to-end Java Swing/JavaFX desktop + citizen web portal with high-availability local/remote SQL persistence.
